lines.en: Kappa-kappa, run!

lines.zh: 河童的壳就在我背上，别碰。
lines.en: A kappa's shell sits on my back; do not touch.
Hmph, Scrya member.
Coming for you, my Blood Magic.
You can't avoid my attacks.
Sunlight won't hurt me.
My kappa shell is still on my back.
Meet me in the water!
Scrya members.
You won't live long.

lines.zh: 我从水边滑过，没有声音。
lines.en: I slip along the water's edge without a sound.

lines.zh: 湿漉漉的脚掌踩过河石。
lines.en: My wet feet pad across the river stones.
I'm watching.
I crouch on a stone and count the water.
Hidden during the day.
A kappa's shell sits on my back.
Fresh prey tastes good.
Waiting in the river.
A kappa's shell grows cold at night.
Waiting for night.
Night is my time.
Ambushing here.
You stepped on the wet riverside mud.
Scrya member?
Your position is revealed.
Be careful, I'm watching.
You can't escape.
I've got you in my sights.
Don't try to run.
I can see through you.

lines.zh: 河童的盘子还在我头上。
lines.en: The kappa's plate is still on my head.

lines.zh: 河童的碗里，还盛着你的影子。
lines.en: My kappa bowl still holds your reflection.
Ouch, the blood is leaking...
This wound hurts so much...
Got hurt again... Such a nuisance...
Got bit on the leg...
This arrow really hurts...
Lightning hit me... Ouch...
Got punched again...
Got cut with a knife...

lines.zh: 壳上裂了一道，水从缝里渗进来。
lines.en: A crack in my shell; water seeps in.
Such bad luck...

lines.zh: 你那把刀真好看，等我吃掉你！
lines.en: Your sword is beautiful, but you will be my next meal.

lines.zh: 别靠近，不然我让你求生不得求死不能！
lines.en: Don't come closer, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 尝尝我这血鬼术的厉害吧！
lines.en: Feel the power of my Blood Sacrifice Technique.
Here, little members of the Demon Slayer Corps!

lines.zh: 阳光下见，那时你就完了！
lines.en: The sun awaits, and it will be your end.

lines.zh: 你手里的黄瓜我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the cucumber in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲挡得住我的刀？哈哈！
lines.en: Your armor can't stop my blade? Hahaha!
Run, or I'll catch you!

lines.zh: 你们不是人类，我是夜的使者！
lines.en: You're not human, I'm the messenger of the night.

lines.zh: 你要是杀了我，太阳会吞噬你！
lines.en: If you kill me, the sun will consume you.
You're too slow, you can't catch me!

lines.zh: 别碰我，我会咬掉你的脑袋！
lines.en: Don't touch me, I'll bite off your head!

lines.zh: 小心我的鬼刀，它们锋利无比！
lines.en: Be careful of my ghost blades, they're incredibly sharp!

lines.zh: 躲开，否则你会变成我的晚餐！
lines.en: Get away, or you'll be my meal!

lines.zh: 我的速度你追不上，快投降！
lines.en: You can't keep up with me, surrender!
Your teammates can't avoid me either!

lines.zh: 你跑不赢我，我会永远追逐你！
lines.en: You can't outrun me, I'll chase you forever!

lines.zh: 我就像黑夜的影子，你找不到我！
lines.en: I'm like the shadow of the night, you can't find me!
You're too close, I can't avoid you!

lines.zh: 你的攻击太弱，对付不了我！
lines.en: Your attacks are too weak, you can't defeat me!.

lines.zh: 找到你真不容易，来吧，让我们交配！
lines.en: I've found you, let's mate now!

lines.zh: 我的同类在哪里？我想要繁殖！
lines.en: Where are my kind? I want to breed!
The eggs at the riverbed need guarding.

lines.zh: 交配是我们的天性，不要拒绝！
lines.en: Mating is our nature, don't refuse!

lines.zh: 你看起来强壮，和我交配吧！
lines.en: You look strong, mate with me!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，跟我一起交配！
lines.en: My partner, mate with me!

lines.zh: 不要抗拒，交配是自然法则！
lines.en: Don't resist, mating is a natural law!

lines.zh: 和我交配，你将获得我的力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, and you'll gain my power!

lines.zh: 快来，和我交配，让我们一起繁衍！
lines.en: Come, mate with me, let's breed together!

lines.zh: 你的同类在哪里？我们来繁衍！
lines.en: Where are your kind? Let's breed!.

lines.zh: 咕嘟一声，Kappa Demon从水中冒出。
lines.en: A splash and the Kappa Demon surfaces.
I'll have your water!
Taste my blood!
You’re see-through in the sun!
Rum rum, I’m going to eat you!
You can’t escape my blood magic!
Night is my domain!

lines.zh: 我把那东西拖进浅水里。
lines.en: I drag it into the shallows.
Rum, drink my blood!
I am the Kappa Demon!
This river bend is mine.
Here, Slayer!
There is blood on your sleeve.
A Demon Slayer — you're not getting away.

lines.zh: 水边的河童，抓住你的脚踝。
lines.en: A kappa by the water takes your ankle.
Rum rum, I’m going to eat you!
Your blood is tasty!
You can’t avoid my attacks!

lines.zh: 你腰间的刀一亮，我就知道该下水了。
lines.en: Your blade catches the light, and I know it's time for the river.
Rum rum, enjoy it!

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着刀，是鬼杀队。
lines.en: You carry a blade at your hip. A Demon Slayer.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的日轮刀味。
lines.en: I smell nichirin steel on you.

lines.zh: 血鬼术已经铺到你脚下。
lines.en: My Blood Demon Art is already under your feet.
The river will hold you down for me.
You carry the blood I want.
You’ll beg for death!
A kappa demon's shell, ten points thick.
Demon Slayer, you die!

lines.zh: 阳光快来，我先躲进芦苇。
lines.en: Sunlight is coming, I hide in the reeds.

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，享受我的攻击吧！
lines.en: Rum rum, enjoy my attack!
My blood magic, you can’t escape!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队，你们是我的猎物！
lines.en: Slayer, you’re my prey!
A splash, and here I come!

lines.zh: 阳光下，你只能等待死亡！
lines.en: In the sun, you await your death!

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，品尝我的力量吧！
lines.en: Rum rum, taste my power!

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几步到水边。
lines.en: I count the steps left before the water.
Blood on my fingertips hardens into needles.
The water begins to bubble.
I arch my back, ready to spring.
Can you draw faster than I move?
I glide a little closer along the ground.

lines.zh: 血鬼术的纹路爬上了手臂。
lines.en: The marks of my art crawl up my arm.
I have plenty of time before dawn.

lines.zh: 我的水盘在头顶晃，别急。
lines.en: The water dish on my head sways, wait.

lines.zh: 血鬼术在我指间积成水珠。
lines.en: My blood art gathers into droplets.
Raging towards you!
Tearing you apart with claws!

lines.zh: 河童鬼，水里的触手归我管。
lines.en: Kappa demon. The water tentacles are mine.
Emitting a terrifying screech!
Colliding with your head!
Licking you to drain life!
Entering battle, fearlessly!
Attacking! With blood magic!
Biting you with fangs!
Swinging weapons wildly!

lines.zh: 血针从水里射向你的腿！
lines.en: Blood needles shoot from the water at your legs!

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕往下拖！
lines.en: I seize your wrist and drag you down!
My claws rake across your scabbard!

lines.zh: 河水卷起来，压你的膝盖！
lines.en: The river rises and crushes your knees!

lines.zh: 我咬住你的肩膀，吸一口！
lines.en: I bite your shoulder and drink deep!

lines.zh: 血鬼术炸开，你退了两步！
lines.en: My art bursts and you stagger back two steps!
I drive my skull into your ribs!
You can block a blade, but not the water!
Night dew falls and I open my eyes.
Appearing in the dark, seeking prey!
Appearing in the shadows!
Emerging from shadows, attacking!

lines.zh: 在月光下现身，准备战斗！
lines.en: Appearing under moonlight, ready for battle!

lines.zh: 月光一照，我从河底爬上来。
lines.en: Moonlight calls me up from the riverbed.
Appearing silently in the night!
Acting under the moonlight!
I'm strongest in the darkness!
Appearing at midnight!

lines.zh: 河底的泥翻了上来，我醒了。
lines.en: The riverbed mud churns. I am awake.

lines.zh: 月光落上水面，我爬上岸。
lines.en: Moonlight hits the water and I climb ashore.
At night I rise out of the waterweeds.

lines.zh: 水面裂开一道口子，是我。
lines.en: The water splits open. It is me.
The fire is burning my skin...
Fell down and it hurts...
Drowning feels terrible...
The explosion's shockwave hurts...
Arrow hit me...
Magical attack hurts...
Starving hurts...
Lightning struck me... Ouch...
Fell into the void... So cold...
